summary: Short lane end squeezed between apartment blocks; dwellings within 15 m.

best_section.where: End of the narrow lane just north-west of the pin, beside the apartment car spaces

drivers.seclusion: Cunningham Apartments 15 m and Powerhouse Terraces 19 m away; more blocks all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane reaches the pin, with a few cars parked at its end; little room beyond.
drivers.traffic: Low traffic, but overlooked from balconies on every side.
drivers.convention: Cars parked look like residents, so a van would stand out.

flags: Dwelling within 10 to 20 m of the only stopping place
Low-lying at 2.4 to 3.6 m, Brisbane River about 295 m away
Pin sits on a pedestrian strip, not a road
sun_shade: Mixed: tree shade from the south-east, apartment blocks shade the west and north.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane is public or private
